_comment: Simple Traits shipped defaults. Put personal changes in SimpleTraits.user.json (same layout, only the keys you change, plus "config_version": 1). Invalid values are ignored one by one.

debug._comment_verbose: Set true to enable trace logging.
debug._comment_allocation_page: Set true to show a temporary Simple Traits / Debug page in SKSE Menu Framework for spending trait points. Testing only.
debug._comment_max_log_files: Maximum number of session logs to keep in the standard SKSE log directory (0 keeps all; valid range 0-1000).

points._comment: Trait points earned = starting_points + floor(level / levels_per_point). Unspent points carry over. Lowering these never removes points already spent. starting_points 0-100, levels_per_point 1-100.

per_point._comment_critical_chance: Agility: critical hit chance per point, in percent (1.0 = +1%; 0-10).
per_point._comment_intelligence_threshold_reductio: Intelligence: fraction of XP needed per level removed per point (0.02 = 2%; 0-0.5). The multiplier never goes below 0.5, and Simple Alternate Levelling applies its own floor too.
per_point._comment_charisma_price_improvement: Charisma: fraction the barter price factor drops per point (0.01 = buy about 1% cheaper and sell about 1% dearer; 0-0.05). Selling never pays more than buying costs.
